appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is '0-19 years vs 20-39 years'.
x-axis is labeled 'Year' and shows tick marks for 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, and 2020.
Blue line with solid circles represents the 0-19 years cohort.
Red line with square markers represents the 20-39 years cohort.
The blue line at 2012 has a data point labeled '89254'.
The red line at 2012 has a data point labeled '92207'.

printed_facts.fact: The 2012 population for the 0-19 years cohort is 89,254.
The 2012 population for the 20-39 years cohort is 92,207.

public_definitions: Use the public demographic planning dashboard as the evidence source for deciding which 2012 age-cohort population is larger.

Review the public demographic planning dashboard, compare the 2012 population for 0-19 years and 20-39 years, then open the age-cohort planning follow-up record for the cohort with the larger 2012 population.
